# CRAFT GTM

> CRAFT GTM is a free web app and AI connector with ten planning tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for founders and CMOs. Give it your metrics, launch date, customers or competitors, and it returns a product-market fit scorecard, a launch plan, playbooks or battle cards. Add https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix GTM Planning plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ff9b14e88191af87f46ab0b5f6b4

- Web app (no sign-in): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Use it in ChatGPT: install the Helix GTM Planning plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ff9b14e88191af87f46ab0b5f6b4
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Hosted version 2.2.24 with 10 tools. Local stdio command: `npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-gtm-mcp`. npm latest on 15 November 2026: 2.2.23.
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Helix skills packages: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [PMF Scorecard](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/pmf-scorecard/) (`pmf_scorecard`): Helps you decide whether you have product market fit and whether to scale: it takes your product, target market and current metrics (MRR, ACV, churn, NPS, CAC, LTV, retention, activation and similar) and returns a scorecard that scores each dimension against example benchmark ranges. It also gives priority actions and the data gaps to fill, reads the business model from your inputs, leaves the activation score out for services, connectivity and investment businesses, and quotes and answers your customer feedback.
- [Launch Commander](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/launch-commander/) (`launch_commander`): Helps you decide your launch plan: it takes what you are launching, the launch type, your target segments and your goals, and returns a phased launch plan with tasks, a messaging table and success metrics. Give a date for a dated timeline, or 'TBD' or a quarter such as 'Q2 2027' for a flexible plan. Tasks and messaging follow the sector and business model read from your inputs, and each goal is filed under its own metric.
- [Customer Interview Kit](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/customer-interview-kit/) (`customer_interview_kit`): Helps you decide what to ask customers to test your hunch: it takes the interview type, the product context and the person you are interviewing, and returns an interview guide that fits the interview type, the sector and the product complexity. Questions use the sector's own language (the sector is chosen, or read from your inputs), your hypotheses are kept whole, and synthesis templates are included.
- [Retention Playbook](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/retention-playbook/) (`retention_playbook`): Helps you decide why customers leave and what to do about each reason: it takes your customer segment, business model and current churn rate, and returns a retention playbook with health signals, interventions and an email draft for each churn reason. If you do not know why customers leave, leave the churn reasons out and you get a churn discovery kit instead. Your current interventions and data signals are used when you give them.
- [Partner Architect](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/partner-architect/) (`partner_architect`): Helps you decide what partner program to run and how to start it: it takes your company, product, partner model, partner goal and deal size, and returns a partner program with tiers, example commission amounts and KPIs. The structure differs for resellers, referrals, integrations, agencies, affiliates and white label, uses your existing partners when given, and names the partner types that fit your sector's buying committee.
- [Crisis Planner](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/crisis-planner/) (`crisis_planner`): Helps you decide who does what when a crisis hits: it takes your company, industry, customer base and data sensitivity, and returns crisis playbooks with a response team and notification steps for each crisis. Name the crises you know of to get those playbooks; without them it uses a default set of common crises for your sector, not ranked by likelihood. Each compliance item you list is used in the notification steps.
- [Competitive Intel](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/competitive-intel/) (`competitive_intel`): Helps you decide how to win against each competitor: it takes your product and the competitors you name, and returns one battle card per competitor built from your strengths, weaknesses, competitor details, objections, wins and losses. Each competitor detail goes to the competitor it names, each objection gets its own answer, and strengths and gaps taken from wins and losses stay in your own words.
- [CRAFT GTM Analyzer](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/craft-gtm-analyzer/) (`craft_gtm_analyzer`): Helps you decide whether a GTM plan is clear enough to run: it takes the text of a GTM document or plan and returns a score for each CRAFT dimension, based only on what the plan contains. Timeline counts real dates, durations and quarters; the answer shows the plan's own line for each dimension, names only the elements that are missing and suggests sections to add.
- [Scale Paid Check](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/scale-paid-check/) (`scale_paid_check`): Helps you decide whether to scale paid now: it takes your customer list (signing date, segment, monthly fee and any stop or return dates) and your churn reasons, and returns, for each customer group, scale, run a capped test, or hold, with the counts behind it, the stop rule, payback, a first draft response to each churn reason and a churn interview guide.
- [Segment and Seat Cut Check](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/segment-and-seat-cut-check/) (`segment_and_seat_cut_check`): Helps you decide which customer segment to back, and whether your pricing is safe if AI cuts seats: it takes each segment's ACV, sales cycle, accounts, deal source and CAC, its logo, gross and net retention, how you charge in your own words, and your seller ramp, cost and qualified demand, and returns one page per segment with payback, gross profit per dollar of CAC, seller capacity after ramp and cycle, and the renewal if customers cut a share of seats. Ask the person to confirm the segment split, their own win rate and what customers can cut before marking each as confirmed; anything not confirmed or not given is shown as missing, never guessed.

## Questions and answers

### What is CRAFT GTM?

CRAFT GTM is a free web app and AI connector with ten planning tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for founders and CMOs. Give it your metrics, launch date, customers or competitors, and it returns a product-market fit scorecard, a launch plan, playbooks or battle cards. Add https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix GTM Planning plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae0ff9b14e88191af87f46ab0b5f6b4

### Is CRAFT GTM free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the CRAFT GTM code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. What you type and the answer are not stored, and nothing you type is logged. Only an anonymous count of tool calls is kept. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use CRAFT GTM in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it CRAFT GTM, paste https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Connect your app covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, the brand he has worked under in Bengaluru since 2022. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-gtm-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is CRAFT GTM not ideal for?

Teams that want finished, publish-ready plans: each tool returns a structured draft, with placeholders where your inputs gave no fact. Anyone who needs live market or competitor data: the tools look nothing up; they work from what you type, and anything they add themselves is marked as an example, a suggestion or a placeholder. Teams that need saved history or shared workspaces: answers are not stored, so keep each result where you keep your work.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp/issues.

## Buyer routes

- [All Helix tools](https://tools.gtmhelix.com/tools/): 52 tools and 37 different skills, 89 in all, in six connectors and nine plugins.
- [Check your B2B product market fit](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/pmf-scorecard/): Use this product market fit scorecard to review the metrics you already track for one B2B segment. Enter the period with retention, revenue and customer evidence, read each dimension separately, then investigate the gaps. The result helps plan the next check. It does not prove that the product has market fit.

- [Scale Paid Check Site](https://helix-scale-paid-check.shashwat-helix-gtm.chatgpt.site/): Choose paid payback, customer staying power or capped lifetime value before increasing paid ads.
